title: Metrics Event
description: Schema for structured metrics events emitted by agent pipeline skills to ~/.claude/tasks/<project>/metrics.jsonl

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event was emitted

event_type.description: The type of pipeline event. Extend this enum when new emit points are added with a named consumer.

agent.description: The agent or skill that emitted this event (e.g. 'ticket-pickup', 'cyrus-tdd-engineer', 'ticket-swarm')

project.description: The project name (basename of git repo root). Used to partition metrics by project.

ticket.description: Jira ticket key (e.g. PROJ-1234). Optional — absent for swarm-level events with no single ticket.

run_id.description: Swarm run ID (e.g. 2026-04-21-001). Links emit events to a specific swarm run log.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Shape depends on event_type.

oneOf.description: ticket_classified — emitted by ticket-pickup after the classification gate resolves

override.description: User override: null=no override, simplified=user chose s, escalated=user chose e

oneOf.description: pipeline_complete — emitted by ticket-pickup (orchestration) or cyrus-tdd-engineer (implementation) after pipeline returns

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from pipeline launch to return

tests_passed.description: Null only when outcome is advisory (no code was produced to test).

coverage_percent.description: Test coverage percentage from Cyrus's report. Null if not reported.

ci_fix_attempts.description: Number of CI fix iterations. 0 if first-pass success.

first_pass.description: True if pipeline completed with 0 retries and 0 CI fix attempts. Null only when outcome is advisory; consumers exclude those from the first-pass denominator.

outcome.description: implemented (default when absent): code was produced. advisory: the pipeline ended deliberately with no code change because the correct answer was not a code change (Aristotle Phase 0 wrong-tool verdict, or a Move stating no code changes are needed). Advisory is a success outcome, distinct from blocked.

advisory_reason.description: One-line verdict when outcome is advisory. Absent otherwise.

oneOf.description: agent_truncated — emitted by pipeline skills when a reasoning agent's response is missing the <<task-complete>> sentinel (suspected maxTurns truncation)

max_turns.description: The maxTurns value set in the truncated agent's frontmatter

context.description: Calling context — swarm (from ticket-swarm), pipeline (non-swarm skill chain), standalone (direct invocation)

parent_skill.description: Name of the skill that invoked the truncated agent. Optional.

oneOf.description: swarm_complete — emitted by ticket-swarm after the run log is written

advisory.description: Tickets whose pipeline ended with a correct no-code answer (pipeline_complete outcome: advisory). Optional for legacy events; treated as 0 when absent.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds from swarm start to summary

agents_spawned.description: Total subagents launched across all pipelines

oneOf.description: multi_repo_split — emitted by ticket-pickup on both paths of multi-repo detection: gate resolution (mode 'gate') and notice-only (mode 'notice'). Uses ticket (parent key), not run_id. Full field documentation in multi-repo-split-event.schema.json.

mode.description: gate = split gate shown; notice = signals detected without resolution evidence (false-positive denominator)

gate_choice.description: Null iff mode is notice; subtask_keys and final_order are empty arrays then
